On every unit input x, expansion and cancellation over all signs gives the exact mean ||sum ε_j T_jx||²=sum ||T_jx||². The largest signed operator norm therefore dominates the joint 2-norm; no attainment of an operator-norm supremum is needed in infinite dimension. For p≤2 the factor k^(1/p−1/2) relating joint p- to 2-norms combines with k^(1/q) to give sqrt(k). For p≥2, the largest individual norm gives k^(1/p) instead.
